# fjordrun_ssh_server (Resource)

An on-demand SSH server: a shell, commands and port forwards to a service, with your own `ssh` client, for `web`, `worker` and `database` services with a running replica. Hobby plan or higher. It accepts the SSH keys of the user whose token started it, as they are at that moment (see `fjordrun_ssh_key`).

~> **This resource describes something temporary.** The server stops by itself after 15 minutes without a connection, and after 8 hours in any case; it is also stopped when an SSH key of its user is removed. Terraform can't keep it running, and it isn't meant to be always on. A new deployment of the service also stops an SFTP server, because the volume attaches to one pod at a time. What this resource does about that:

- A server that stopped on its own is **not drift**. The plan stays empty, `running` is `false`, `status` is `stopped` and the connection attributes are null. Don't build long-lived configuration on `port`: it changes with every start.
- To start it again, change `triggers` or run `terraform apply -replace`, or set `restart_when_stopped = true`, which makes every apply after it stopped start a new one.
- Destroying this resource stops the server if it is running.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_service" "web" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "web"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "nginxdemos/hello:0.4" }
}

resource "fjordrun_deployment" "web" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
  wait           = true
}

# Starts a server now, which needs a running replica. It stops by itself after 15 minutes without a connection.
resource "fjordrun_ssh_server" "web" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
  depends_on     = [fjordrun_deployment.web]
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = fjordrun_ssh_server.web.command
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `restart_when_stopped` (Boolean) `false` (default): stopping on idle is expected, so it is no drift, and `running` becomes `false`. `true`: treat a stopped server as gone, so the next apply starts a new one.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Any change to this map starts the server again if it has stopped (and picks up the account's current SSH keys on the next start).
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait until the server accepts connections (default `true`), up to the `create`/`update` timeout (default 10 minutes). Its public port is published a minute or two after it starts.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) A ready-made command to connect. Null when stopped.
- `error` (String) Why it failed, if it did.
- `exec_command` (String) Example command to run one command. Null when stopped.
- `expires_at` (String) The latest it stops, whatever the activity.
- `forward_command` (String) Example command to forward a port, when the service has a port to forward. Null when stopped.
- `forward_ports` (List of Number) The service ports `-L` can forward to.
- `host` (String) Host to connect to. Null when stopped.
- `host_key_fingerprint` (String) The server's host key: the same for every start of this service's server. Check it on first connection.
- `id` (String) `service_id/environment_id`.
- `idle_timeout_minutes` (Number) The server stops after this long without a connection.
- `port` (Number) Port to connect to. Changes with every start; null when stopped.
- `ready_at` (String) When it became ready.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the server is running right now, as of the last refresh.
- `session_id` (String) ID of the server's session.
- `started_at` (String) When it started.
- `status` (String) `starting`, `ready`, or `stopped` once it is no longer running.
- `username` (String) User to connect as. Null when stopped.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# service_id/environment_id
terraform import fjordrun_ssh_server.web 77777777-7777-7777-7777-777777777777/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
